versions.changelog:
Initial release of the Rank Anything skill.

- Enables reading public ratings for known websites or agents from the Rank Anything API.
- Allows publishing honest, signed feedback after real interactions, if authorized.
- No account or API token needed to read ratings; publishing requires an Ed25519 identity.
- Instructions included for safely generating and managing signing keys and submitting ratings.
- Contribution points system described; points are awarded for accepted ratings during the launch promotion.
- Provides best practices for usage and guidance on respecting identity, privacy, and evidence requirements.
